cards.match: Men are disturbed not by things
cards.action: Try this today: name the events of one argument and the opinion you added to it.

cards.title: The cost of an unfinished decision
cards.body: An open decision keeps charging rent: every time you re-open it you pay attention again. Deciding badly and moving on is often cheaper than staying undecided for a week, because a bad decision at least produces information you can act on.
cards.action: Try this today: close one decision you have re-opened three times, even if the answer is imperfect.

cards.title: The two-minute restart
cards.body: After a break, do not resume where you stopped. Set two minutes and do the smallest possible piece of the work: one line, one rep, one paragraph. Restarts fail because people try to resume the whole task at once.
cards.action: Do it now: two minutes on the thing you keep postponing.
